# BanG Dream! character-voice TTS (unofficial fan model)

> BanG Dream! (邦邦 / バンドリ) character-voice TTS: 49 voices + 25 opt-in Our Notes voices (MyGO!!!!!, Ave Mujica, Girls Band Party, Our Notes). They speak Japanese, Mandarin and English with no reference audio. A Qwen3-TTS fine-tune. Unofficial fan project, not affiliated with Bushiroad, Craft Egg, the BanG Dream! project, the official 夢ノ結唱 voicebanks or the voice cast.

**Install and run:**
- `pip install qwen-tts`.
- `Qwen3TTSModel.from_pretrained("starrydark/BanG_Dream_Qwen3_TTS")`, then `generate_custom_voice(text=..., speaker="mygo_anon", language="Chinese")`.
- For the 25 Our Notes voices (`ikka_*`, `mewtype_*`, `millsage_*`, `ournotes_kanata`, `*_ournotes`), add `revision="ournotes"`.
- Always pass `language` ("Japanese", "Chinese" or "English").
- From mainland China, set `HF_ENDPOINT=https://hf-mirror.com`.

**Rules for outputs:** AI-generated audio must be labelled as AI-generated, which is required in China since 2025-09-01. No commercial use and no impersonation of the voice cast. The BanG Dream! fan-work guideline prohibits derivative works that use the franchise's audio (item 10). The model is taken down on request.

## Use
- [Model card (main, 49 voices)](https://huggingface.co/starrydark/BanG_Dream_Qwen3_TTS): speaker ids, Chinese names, per-voice quality, limitations, rights
- [Model card (ournotes branch, 25 voices)](https://huggingface.co/starrydark/BanG_Dream_Qwen3_TTS/blob/ournotes/README.md)
- [Online demo](https://huggingface.co/spaces/starrydark/BanG_Dream_Qwen3_TTS): Gradio Space with all 74 voices
- [README](https://github.com/starryark/bangdream-tts/blob/main/README.md): usage, FAQ, results summary
- [中文说明](https://github.com/starryark/bangdream-tts/blob/main/README.zh-CN.md)
